finding_history.evidence: packages/app-backend/src/jobs-bridge.ts:86 marks deliveredAt after transport success; packages/core/src/inngest.ts:42 configures only three retries; :45 calls admission; packages/core/src/jobs-application.ts:44 invokes assertAuthority/activeCell before :62 persists any receipt. tests/backend-jobs-ingress.test.ts demonstrates HOLD rejects before receipt creation.
finding_history.refutation: The engine durably stores accepted events and can retry SDK failures. That does not guarantee admission: a HOLD/suspension beginning after dispatch authorization can outlast all finite retries, leaving a permanently failed engine run and an acknowledged source intent with no Foundation receipt. The source dispatcher never revisits delivered rows.
finding_history.suggestion: Keep the source intent pending until a durable domain receipt exists, or persist a retryable cell inbox before lifecycle admission and resume it after HOLD; test engine acceptance followed by prolonged HOLD and eventual release.
finding_history.resolution: Resolved and independently source-reviewed; reviewer reproductions and supplied regression/native evidence confirm corrected paths

finding_history.evidence: packages/core/src/jobs-application.ts:62 stores envelope: input in global owner Store; packages/store/src/jobs-schema.ts:23 defines its full envelope column; packages/core/src/jobs-execution.ts:56 and :76 load that envelope into handler context. docs/spec/isolation.md:97 requires control DB remain metadata rather than shared app DB; :105 excludes full application payloads from the surviving effect journal.

finding_history.evidence: packages/app-backend/src/jobs-bridge.ts:34 counts only undelivered rows against maxPending and :86 only marks deliveredAt. packages/store/src/jobs-schema.ts:16–26 retains full global envelopes. Scoped references show no payload deletion/redaction path for either event table; packages/core/src/jobs-retention.ts:85 prunes only runs/outbox. docs/spec/v1.md:F41 and docs/spec/isolation.md retention defaults require configured retention.
finding_history.refutation: Unresolved receipts and deduplication identities must survive replay/recovery windows, but retaining all successful event payloads forever is not needed for that invariant. A steady stream of accepted/delivered events bypasses maxPending and grows both stores without a configured settled-payload bound.
finding_history.suggestion: Define cell payload retention and storage admission separately from retained metadata receipts; never prune unresolved business intent or recreate work after payload cleanup.
